name: booksguard
description: Nothing an AI writes to QuickBooks or Xero posts until you say yes. A PreToolUse hook holds every create, update, delete, void and send through the QuickBooks and Xero MCP servers and their REST APIs, shows a dry-run diff with totals and journal balance, releases the identical call once on your own message, and keeps a hash-chained log per client on your machine. Reads pass. Runs npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/booksguard locally; no account, no network of its own, no LLM calls.
